mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with simultaneous RSAFS and HOUST declines for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals strong economic momentum that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with rising UNRATE over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate investment and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 105 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with simultaneous RSAFS and HOUST declines for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
